scheme_name: Purchase of Vehicle for Commercial Hiring Purpose for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Age must be above 18 years; for persons with mental retardation, minimum age is 14 years
The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana
License must comply with the policy of the National Corporation
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹10 lakh for commercial hiring and up to ₹25 lakh for purchase of special category vehicles for persons with disability of ≥40%.
